findings.summary: The current browser artifact reports all 49 viewport/scenario cells complete with runtimePass=true; 18 route checks report a main landmark, focusable route titles, no missing controls and no unlabeled rows. The route-detail workflow exercises explicit Back plus browser Back/Forward, while source restores the selected row focus. The tablet radio group uses radio semantics, roving tabindex and Arrow/Home/End handling.

The current report records 44px-or-larger action controls and no horizontal overflow in the inspected workflow. The seven original single-scene screenshots cover phone 320/390/430, landscape 667/844 and tablet 768/1199; the phone screenshots retain the persistent tab bar and the landscape/tablet screenshots retain the selected-object workbench.

This artifact is Playwright/browser evidence only. It contains no physical iOS device or VoiceOver session proving screen-reader traversal, focus order and restoration, native form/radio announcements, bottom safe-area reachability, or Back/Forward behavior in the shipped mobile environment.
findings.action: On a physical supported iPhone, capture a reproducible VoiceOver acceptance run through overview, route row/detail/return, bottom tabs, connection form and tablet-style radio selection where applicable; include Dynamic Type and safe-area observations, then regenerate the runtime evidence.
